business.description: HP Adhesives Limited is a diversified manufacturer and distributor of adhesives, sealants and allied solutions, serving applications across plumbing, construction, furniture, automotive, footwear and home improvement. The company operates from its manufacturing facility at Village Narangi, Taluka Khalapur, District Raigad, Maharashtra.

products.name: Solvent Cement
products.note: Fast-setting, durable and leak-proof bonding solution for PVC, CPVC and uPVC pipes and fittings

products.name: Silicone Sealants
products.note: Strong Seal range includes General Purpose, Weather Sealant, Glass & Aquarium, Acrylic Sealant, Neutral Silicone

products.name: SR Adhesive & PVA
products.note: Contact adhesives and water-based Polyvinyl Acetate adhesives for woodworking, carpentry, furniture, foam & furnishings, automotive and footwear

products.name: Ball Valves & Tapes
products.note: High-quality valves for PVC/CPVC plumbing systems and PTFE (Teflon) tapes for plumbing

products.name: New Products
products.note: Comprises MS Polymer sealants, Epoxy products, Spray Paints, Cyanoacrylates and Tile Cleaner

products.name: Others
products.note: Ancillary products including PU Foam, Liquid Sealants, Shellac, Rubber Lubricants

products.name: Epoxy Adhesives
products.note: Sold under the 'StrongTite' brand, suitable for bonding a wide variety of substrates. Comprises two variants: ULTIMATE Epoxy Adhesive (pot life approx. 45-50 minutes) and ZATPAT Epoxy Adhesive (pot life approx. 2-3 minutes).

products.name: Contact Adhesives and PVA Adhesives
products.note: Marketed under the 'Strong Fix' brand, covers PVA adhesives used principally as woodworking glue in furniture and interior applications, alongside rubber (contact) adhesives used across woodworking, foam furnishings, automotive interiors, footwear manufacturing, and handicrafts. Offered in both sprayable and brushable formats across multiple SKUs.

products.name: Ball Valves and Tapes
products.note: Ball valves, PTFE tape, and masking tape sold as complementary products alongside the core solvent cement range.

products.name: Epoxy Putty
products.note: Sold under the 'StrongTite' brand, comprises three variants: General Purpose Epoxy Putty, Sanitary Epoxy Putty for plumbing and sanitary installations, and Fast Epoxy Putty for time-sensitive repair work.

products.name: Spray Paints
products.note: Covers both indoor and outdoor use, including home decor and automotive refinishing applications, positioned on fast-drying times, surface coverage, and resistance to chipping, fading, and peeling.

products.name: Cyanoacrylates
products.note: Two cyanoacrylate (instant-bonding) variants suited to general fastening applications, valued for rapid cure time, bond strength, and ease of use across a range of substrate materials.

products.name: Ancillary Products
products.note: Black and White Sealants, Pipe Lubricant, and Gasket Shellacs.

outlook.statement: Government initiatives focused on infrastructure development, manufacturing growth, housing and industrial expansion are expected to create significant opportunities for the sector. The Company remains optimistic about the long-term prospects of both the Indian economy and the adhesives industry.

A key objective is to accelerate the growth of new products launched in the previous financial year, while increasing efforts to further deepen the penetration of core product categories such as Solvent Cement and Silicone Sealants.

The Company's priorities for the year ahead centre on restoring Unit I to full production, maintaining product quality standards across its portfolio, and ensuring customers are catered to in an uninterrupted manner.
Sustained government capital expenditure, particularly under the Jal Jeevan Mission and AMRUT, is expected to support construction and plumbing-related demand through the year.

The Indian adhesives market is estimated to grow from approximately USD 3.07 bn in 2025 to USD 3.28 bn in 2026 and is projected to reach around USD 4.58 bn by 2031, a CAGR of approximately 6.88% over the 2026 to 2031 forecast period.

The Indian construction market reached approximately Rs 25.31 tn in 2026, growing approximately 11.2% over the year, and is projected to grow at a CAGR of approximately 8.8% through 2030, reaching close to Rs 39.10 tn.
The Indian plastic pipes market, valued at approximately USD 7.40 bn in 2025, is projected to more than double to approximately USD 16.54 bn by 2031, a CAGR of approximately 14.18%.

The Company expects that the measures undertaken towards operational efficiency, cost optimisation, business expansion, product development and market penetration will contribute to improved productivity and profitability.

Emphasis of Matter: Fire incident on 17th January 2026 at the Company's manufacturing Plant-Unit-I located at Survey no. 7, Narangi Village, Khalapur, Khopoli, District Raigad (Maharashtra), resulting in damage to certain property, plant and equipment, inventories and other assets. Company has initially recognised an estimated loss for Rs. 2,498.50 lakhs under Exceptional Item and a corresponding insurance claim receivable as other current financial assets based on a preliminary assessment. Company is in the process of finalising and lodging the insurance claim, and the survey and loss assessment by the insurance company are ongoing. There is inherent uncertainty in respect of the measurement of the insurance claim receivable, and the final outcome may differ from the amount currently recognised. Opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.
